facts.statement: Everything on one level; a grandparent visits for weeks at a time.
Kitchen open to the living room, but cooking smells should not reach bedrooms.
Two bedrooms now; the children share one.
Bedrooms should face away from the road.
Visiting grandparent can sleep in the living room for now (inferred from budget answers).
